A question about converting our PIBA file to a married status - 

Hi! We recently got married, and after registering myself as married at the registry department, we went to make an appointment to convert our file at the Visa department.

We were told that we first need to file an online request on their website, and they will contact us to make an appointment for conversion.

Is this a new procedure?

On their website I only see an option to open a new visa file for married couples, rather than converting an existing file to "married" status.

I also didn't see a mention of this procedure on the AIC website.

I'm asking because the clerk who helped us was wrong in the past about something else, so want to make sure...
